description: Ghana - Geo-located Solar Stations connected to the grid is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Solar", published or maintained by Ghana Energy Commission (World Bank Group). This dataset consists of grid connected solar installations. Their installed capacities in kilowatts (kW) are also provided. This dataset was last updated in June 2014. Citation: Ghana Energy Commission & Negawatt challenge. A curated list of datasets for the World Bank Negawatt Challenge competition in Accra and Nairobi cities:. Coverage: Ghana. It has 3 files in GeoJSON, SHP ZIP, CSV. The portal files it under Solar. The portal gives 2014 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
